title.zh: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
title.en: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says

current_state.zh: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.
current_state.en: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.

updates.title_zh: 公司称这款AI已能在视频通话中让人误以为自己是真人
updates.title_en: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
updates.what_changed_zh:
Tavus于10月1日发布Griffin，称其为首个“人类交互模型”（Human Interaction Model），可实时理解并生成面对面对话。按该公司自己的测试，54名参与者中有26人（48%）在一分钟视频通话后认为Griffin-Lite版本是真人，而其上一代系统在41人中仅有1人（2.4%）被误认为真人；目前该模型仍仅向少数受信任测试者开放，安全措施仍在推进中。

这一结果出现之际，安全研究人员已记录到深度伪造被用于实时视频通话的案例：今年1月，与朝鲜有关联的黑客在Zoom或Teams通话中用AI生成的视频冒充可信联系人，研究人员将入侵归因于Lazarus Group下属的BlueNoroff，受害者被诱导安装伪装成音频修复程序的恶意软件。

Tavus称Griffin-Lite在英伟达VideoFDB基准测试中排名第一，生成能力项得分3.83（满分5分），次优系统为2.80，人类参考为3.92；在感知能力项上以3.73落后于人类的4.20。Tavus表示该评测由英伟达独立完成。测试并非经典图灵测试——参与者被告知将匹配到另一人进行一分钟通话，仅在最后才被问及是否曾怀疑对方不是真人；X平台上的一条社区注释已指出，上述结果未经独立验证，也不遵循标准测试流程。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.
updates.background_zh: Tavus将Griffin定位为全双工系统，可同时听、看和说，在英伟达H100芯片上音视频平均延迟为0.43秒，Tavus称这是次快方法的一半。Griffin被描述为一个新的模型类别，建立在此前实时感知与富有表现力视频研究之上；加州大学圣地亚哥分校的一项研究发现，OpenAI的GPT-4.5在纯文本对话中让评判者认为它是真人的比例为73%。英伟达的VideoFDB被称为首个评估全双工音视频对话代理的基准测试。
updates.background_en: Tavus presents Griffin as a full-duplex system that listens, watches and talks simultaneously, with average audio-to-video delay of 0.43 seconds on Nvidia H100 chips, which Tavus says is half that of the next fastest method. Griffin is positioned as a new model class following earlier research into real-time perception and expressive video; a UC San Diego study found OpenAI's GPT-4.5 convinced judges it was human in 73% of text-only conversations. Nvidia's VideoFDB is described as the first benchmark evaluating full-duplex audio-visual conversational agents.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在身份验证环节：加密交易所和托管机构依赖实时视频与活体检测完成KYC和账户找回，而更具说服力的实时合成视频与音频会提高这类验证的成本和失效风险，从而推动对更强活体检测与验证手段的需求，而非直接影响任何代币的供给或价格。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through identity assurance: crypto exchanges and custodians rely on live video and liveness checks for KYC and account recovery, and more convincing real-time synthetic video/audio raises the cost and failure risk of those checks, creating demand for stronger liveness detection and verification rather than directly affecting any token's supply or price.
